description: Comprehensive mass/binding table over every (Z, N) in the AME enumeration — 14,972 rows spanning A = 1..418, Z = 0..118 — at the current production tier: Family A λ_A = 5/2 + (3/4)h² (PROVED) + substrate-pure flavor-split Δm/M_N (PROVED, PR #942). Binding energies via binding_canonical with use_closed_form=True for A ≤ 3 (PR #921); A = 4 uses the symbolic path. Each entry cross-references the recursive atom knot atlas methodology tag. PRECISION CAVEAT: the per-generator Wedderburn volumes come from pyhecke.atom.atom_per_generator_volumes, which uses H_3 weights at every A; for A > 1 the correct algebra is H_{3A} and the weights are systematically wrong (docs/audits/2026-05-25-h3-vs-h3a-legacy-bug-audit.md). The proper H_{3A} sum is infeasible past A ≈ 12, so these rows are a coarse diagnostic, not a precision prediction.

q3f7_colour_weight_offset_reconciliation.explanation: Reconciles bean qou-q3f7: at 543e30adfd (2026-08-26), atom_per_generator_volumes evaluated the H_3 mixture w_sym*(q+d) + w_std*(z+d) + w_alt*(-q^-1+d), giving d(ln V_mix)/d(ln f_pn) = 1.494543484206153 (distinct from 3/2) and -alpha*d(ln V_mix) = -0.000791784583416 MeV (-0.000792 MeV at 6 dp, whose 6-dp quotient yielded 1.4949). Under the 2026-11-18 Markov-trace volume V_full = z*a + b = f_pn, the live ratio is 1.

caveats: Production tier uses Family A λ_A = 5/2 + (3/4)h² (PROVED, +2.89% from CODATA on m_p) + substrate-pure flavor-split (PROVED, 0.03% ratio match). Strategy I (λ_Y = λ_A − G·h², +1.33%) is NOT used in this mass table — it requires the Yekutieli bijection proof (research-grade; PR #978 / #991). Binding energies for A ≥ 5 are NOT computed — gated on H_12 Phase-2 (≥3500 test words; PR #944 delivered Phase-1 for A ≤ 4). Atlas methodology tags from prop:recursive-atom-knot-atlas.

H_3 vs H_{3A}: the per-generator Wedderburn volumes feeding the q-CLT column use H_3 weights at every A. For A > 1 the atomic braid lives in H_{3A}(q), so the weights are systematically wrong (audit 2026-05-25-h3-vs-h3a-legacy-bug-audit.md). The correct sum over partitions of 3A is infeasible beyond A ≈ 12 — p(36) ≈ 18,000 and p(120) ≈ 1.8e9 — so no substitution can fix these rows; treat A > 12 as a coarse diagnostic. Measured shape: B_pred/B_AME falls to a plateau of ≈ 0.28 for A ≥ 12, i.e. the model gives ≈ 2.5 MeV per nucleon where nature gives ≈ 8.
